# Data provenance sheet

One sheet per dataset. Replace each placeholder line with your own text.

## Sources

Where did the data come from, and who collected it?

The tickets were collected from the Example Ltd help desk between 2023 and 2024.

## Licence and consent

On what licence or consent basis may the data be used?

The data is internal and used under the customer terms of service, with consent recorded at sign-up.

## Preparation

How was the data cleaned, labelled or annotated?

Personal data was removed in preprocessing, then each ticket was labelled by two annotators.

## Known gaps

What is missing or skewed in the data?

Ticket volume is low for rare product lines, so those classes are under-represented.
